d: Lok aastha aur sury upasna ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar pure jharkhand men bhaktimay mahaul bana huaa hai. mahaparv ke dusre din aaj vratiyon ne shraddha aur bhakti ke sath kharna anushthan kiya. kharna ka prasad grahan karne ke bad vrati 36 ghante ke nirjala upvas ki shuruaat kar rahe hain. kal chhath mahaparv ke tisre din astachalgami bhagvan bhaskar ko pahla arghy arpit kiya jaega. vahin, raksha rajy mantri sanjay seth ne eechagarh vidhanasbha kshetr men jamdih relve ovrabrij ka udghatan kiya. is pul ke shuru hone se kshetr men aavagman sugam hone ke sath hi vyaparik aur aarthik…
